title: Bondi Outdoor Cinema
address: Bondi Pavilion, Bondi Beach NSW 2026, Australia
description: Four free outdoor film screenings at Bondi Pavilion: Jurassic Park (Thu), Supergirl (Fri), Last Christmas (Sat), and Love Actually (Sun). PG and M film classifications vary.
longDescription: Enjoy outdoor cinema by the sea, 7:30–9:30pm each night, 19–22 November. Jurassic Park (PG) Thursday; Supergirl (M) Friday; Last Christmas (PG) Saturday; Love Actually (M) Sunday. Complimentary snacks. Check film classification before bringing children.
ageGuidance: PG screenings on Thursday and Saturday; Friday and Sunday films are classified M
bookingStatus: Free and open to the public; no advance booking specified by council
imageCredit: Waverley Council, Bondi Outdoor Cinema event image
about: Four free outdoor screenings at Bondi Pavilion.

longDescription: Tim Harris and Christopher Nielsen share the making of Funny Fairytales. Free event for children aged 5–12 and their families; book a ticket for every attendee. Live ticket availability has not been confirmed.
